newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Prodi to visit Egypt, Dini to Israel.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Prodi to visit Egypt, Dini to Israel.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi will fly to Cairo on Sunday for talks with President Hosni Mubarak, Prodi's office said on Friday.
A statement said the October 20-21 working visit followed an invitation from the Egyptian president.
A separate announcement said that Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini would visit Israel on October 27 at the invitation of his counterpart David Levy.
Prodi's visit to Egypt will be his first to the Middle East, where Italy is eager to play a greater role in the peace process, since he was appointed prime minister in May.
